Hey - I've found 1 issue

<details>
<summary>Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

~~~markdown
Please address the comments from this code review:

## Individual Comments

### Comment 1
<location path="astrbot/core/astr_main_agent/computer_use.py" line_range="275-278" />
<code_context>
             local_policy.allow_execution
             and not local_policy.allow_network
             and LOCAL_NETWORK_POLICY_NOTICE not in (req.system_prompt or "")
+            and not any(
+                isinstance(part, TextPart) and LOCAL_NETWORK_POLICY_NOTICE in part.text
+                for part in req.extra_user_content_parts
+            )
         ):
-            runtime_prompt += f"\n## Execution policy\n{LOCAL_NETWORK_POLICY_NOTICE}\n"
</code_context>
<issue_to_address>
**Quoted text suppresses policy notice**

When a user-supplied text part contains `LOCAL_NETWORK_POLICY_NOTICE` along with other instructions, `any` treats every text part as an existing policy notice when it contains the notice string, including user-supplied or quoted content with additional contradictory instructions. The intended reminder is then omitted, so the model can attempt disallowed network operations and encounter avoidable denials.

Deduplicate using an exact match or an explicit marker for the generated notice rather than a substring search across arbitrary text parts.
</issue_to_address>
~~~

</details>

### Linked issues

**[#11054](https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/issues/11054) \[Bug\] 「本地执行不可联网」提示按发言人权限 system prompt 中段，群聊共享会话里如果联网权限不同则会导致整轮缓存失效** · 2 of 2 met

| # | Requirement | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Keep the speaker-dependent local network notice out of the shared system prompt so alternating speakers preserve the reusable prompt prefix. | ✅ Met | `apply_computer_use` adds the notice as a temporary `TextPart` in the current request’s user content; the regression test checks that administrator and member system prompts remain equal. |
| 2 | Continue giving the notice to speakers who can execute locally but are not allowed network access. | ✅ Met | The existing permission condition is retained, and the regression test checks that a restricted member receives one temporary notice, excluded from saved history. |

### Sourcery assessment

**Needs a human reviewer.** The network restriction is now supplied as temporary user content rather than part of the runtime prompt, so a model could give it less weight and invoke execution tools in ways the speaker’s policy forbids. Reverting restores the prior placement, but any network request or data exposure that already occurred cannot be undone.

***
